dataList.content:
My name is Yi Sang. That is all.
我是李箱……以上。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Special Lecture Hall
大观园 特殊教室

dataList.content:
The class I have prepared for the day…
今日准备的课程为……

Aha, I’ve heard plenty about your ‘Mirror’ tech.
啊，我对“镜子”早有耳闻。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Which makes me wonder...
不过……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... going by the level of advancement in that technology, couldn't you have approached it from a different "angle"?
以你们的技术，不是可以用别的方法来解决问题吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You know how technological advancement usually goes. People invent for the sake of creation, only to have their inventions inevitably warped into weapons of destruction.
归根结底技术就是这样发展变化的吧。为了某物而生的发明，最后总会破坏其他的某些东西。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Indeed... You show much promise already.
你的确……相当优秀。

As you surmise now, the Mirror has, in the past, almost been employed to shatter possibilities instead of reflecting them.
如你所言……镜子本是映照出可能性的道具，却曾差点被用于打碎可能性。

... I'm sure that's the angle most others wanted to see happen. "Removal of potential risks" sounds much more palatable than "potential" itself to some people, after all.
……那才是大多数人所期望的方向吧。比起可能性，还是排除危险因素更让人感兴趣。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Correct again. Yet, destruction was a word that bore too much suffering for my heart; my sole egress from it was abandonment of my quondam fellows and my life's work—making myself a fugitive from the past.
诚然。但破坏一词于我而言太过伤痛。我所能做的便是将我与旧友们成就的一切弃之不顾，狼狈地逃跑罢了。

How did you bring yourself to just... abandon it all?
你怎么做到……放弃一切的？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I conversed.
只是相互交谈了。

With who?
和谁？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
With my self... that lies within me.
和这之中的……我自己。

As you are aware, the Mirror's reflection extends beyond the veils of our own reality.
众所周知，镜子并不仅仅反映了我们所在的现实。

It reflects the potentialities, the latent strength, and the world.
其也能映照出可能性、潜能以及世界。

Yet, even among them, the reflection of the greatest importance is... that of the self.
而最为重要的……便是反映自身。

Let not the innumerable worlds of the Mirror enchant your gaze; first, one must direct their studies inward and reflect upon oneself.
与镜中无数的外界相比，首先最需重视的是对自我的探究。
